verdict.rationale: Harbor Compliance's platform brings entities and their state registrations together in Entity Manager, with statuses and an interactive map (docs-7, docs-8, docs-20). Received service-of-process documents are delivered electronically (docs-19), and the public OpenAPI spec includes registered-agent-deliveries endpoints (probe-2), so entities, registrations and received documents sit in one platform. Team access is only implied by reminders being 'customizable by user' (docs-20). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of multi-user team accounts, roles or permissions, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the unified account experience.
